name: TextSniper
soft_passes: #3 silhouette: 'target/crosshair' reads when filled solid, but the serif-T 'text' meaning is carried by fine terminals a pure silhouette discards
#4 16px squint: coloured disc + central mark survive; the four thin diagonal stems and serif caps merge to a fuzzy X and detail smears

#10 variant robustness: white reticle is independent of one bg colour, but the whole personality is carried by the cyan->violet gradient; no dark/mono variant renders supplied to confirm authored layers

palette.background: ramp #F5F7FF->#D8F1FF (frosted ice slab, near-white top, pale cyan-tinted edges)

light_model: single top-left environmental glass source: soft top highlight on the frosted base, baked diagonal specular sheen brightening the lens toward top-left, tone deepening to violet bottom-right, short soft contact edge under the lens
layer_stack: system squircle mask + system drop shadow
frosted ice-white squircle base slab (translucent look, cyan-tinted edges)
circular glass lens with cyan->violet TL->BR gradient + specular gloss
white serif-T crosshair reticle (4 marks, stems converging to a central X)
devices: serif-T capture reticle (four serif capital Ts = T-for-Text, stems meeting as an X crosshair, crossbars as selection corner brackets)
floating saturated glass lens on a pale frosted squircle slab (Liquid-Glass object-on-glass depth)
cool cyan->violet diagonal ramp that doubles as the light model
rhymes_hint: instrument-lens capture/OCR/screenshot utilities (viewfinder or crosshair inside the mask); Liquid-Glass object-on-frosted-slab family; cool cyan->violet tech-ramp palettes
notes: 542x542 web downscale, not the 1024 master — lens specular and frosted translucency are estimated, not measured. Faint baked outer shadow in the transparent margin (alpha fringe ~18), likely a macapp.supply composite. Baked lens specular gloss deviates from Icon-Composer 'let the system apply effects' discipline (aesthetically coherent, worth noting for a native rebuild). Strong subject-mining: reticle states 'text' + 'aim' + 'drag a selection box' at once. Cover uses violet ground + a literal crosshair on a selection rectangle, cohering with the icon's violet lens endpoint. 12/12 with 3 soft passes; no hard failures on the non-negotiable 1-4.
